name: Hotel Neuhaus
beschreibung: Hotel Neuhaus (Alpendomizil Neuhaus) is positioned in the heart of Mayrhofen in the Zillertal Valley, close to the Penkenbahn cable car. The resort combines upscale alpine comfort with an expansive wellness complex featuring indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and landscaped gardens. Fine Tyrolean and international dining are served across charming parlour restaurants, offering an ideal base for skiing and high-altitude hiking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Neuhaus (Alpendomizil) in central Mayrhofen features a premier spa with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, fine dining, and immediate proximity to the Penkenbahn.
